matrix_name.name: polyvinyl chloride
matrix_name.description: PVC in powder form, density 1.37, K value (molecular mass) 71, melting point 80°C, glass temperature 87°C

fillers.name: graphite
fillers.description: foliated graphite nanosheets, thickness 30-50 nm, average thickness ~40 nm, mean diameter ~20 mm, prepared by exfoliation and sonication of natural flake graphite; mixed with copper nanoparticles at 90/10 wt% ratio

fillers.name: copper
fillers.description: copper nanoparticles, average particle size 20 nm, prepared by ball milling at 400 rpm for 10 h under argon atmosphere; mixed with graphite nanosheets at 90/10 wt% ratio
